rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold a six-Justice coalition by reversing on narrow-tailoring/administrability grounds within the Bakke/Grutter/Fisher II framework, avoiding a categorical Title VI holding. Thomas (and likely Gorsuch/Alito) have strong incentives to write separately to press the textualist Title VI theory and broader critiques of deference and “critical mass,” while the dissent is likely fragmented between a principal dissent and additional writing.
